additional_info.body:
Hello we are having issues with missing packets from OCPP,
the issue is, when a user starts a transaction, no MeterValues are being sent back to the OCP,
we need help enabling all meter values to be sent back to us via OCPP.
Here is the info on the charger:
v2.11.0-0-geeb1d66
ID Zxa4Mx
I need the charger to be updated, and the MeterValues to be sent each 30 seconds, can you please help?

additional_info.subject: ID0463395-DC/Si-D/BR-[MP/R4 170001785] Meter value issue CRM:02889000874
additional_info.body:
Dear
Angelo Rodem
,
The reason no MeterValues are being sent back to the OCP  is that this charger model does not include meter. Because of that, the station is unable to generate or transmit MeterValues during a transaction.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
